items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Bob — oh God what was his name, the trumpet player? ... Bob something. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Bob Shaffner. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, great trumpet player.

ctx.x: Bob — oh God what was his name, the trumpet player? Real black cat, man, Bob something, he was a lead trumpet player, a beautiful trumpet. Bob something.
